raw.rationale: GW-441756 is a potent, selective NTRK1 (TrkA) inhibitor, and NTRK1 fusions are rare but enriched in certain lineages such as thyroid, colorectal, and infantile fibrosarcoma; in the PRISM 578-cell-line panel, NTRK1 fusion-positive lines are extremely uncommon, so selective killing of any single lineage is unlikely. Published PRISM screens show most compounds are selective for 0-1 lineages, with base rates 0.2-2.5%, and no strong lineage-specific dependency for NTRK1 inhibition is expected at 2.5 µM across these lineages.
